Preserved Primary Document • munce-r2.htm
Robert Munce Jr.
Robert was born in Delaware sometime around
1810
. He was the son of  Robert Munce Sr.  His mother's name is not known for certain but it is believed to have been Margaret.
On 20 May,
1832
he married Jemima HANSOR who was born in Delaware c.
1813
. I don't have any information about Jemima but she was undoubtably connected to the mixed race Hansor family, either the Kent or Sussex counties line.
Robert and Jemima are believed to have had the following children:

Robert Munce Jr.

Preserved Primary Document • munce-r2.htm

Robert Munce Jr. Robert was born in Delaware sometime around 1810. He was the son of Robert Munce Sr. His mother's name is not known for certain but it is believed to have been Margaret. On 20 May, 1832 he married Jemima HANSOR who was born in Delaware c.1813. I don't have any information about Jemima but she was undoubtably connected to the mixed race Hansor family, either the Kent or Sussex counties line. Robert and Jemima are believed to have had the following children: Lydia Munce (1832- 1908) married Benjamin Sammons Josiah Munce (1835- ) married Caroline Dean James H. Munce (1837-1919)married Hester Ann CORK Daniel Munce (c.1838- bef. 1850) Margaret Munce (c.1840-bef. 1850) Mary Elizabeth Munce (8 Sept.1841- ) married Nehemiah Sammons Hannah Munce (c.1843- ) Angelina Munce (1843-1917) married Enoch Dean Angelica Munce (1848-1919) married George Miller Robert Munce (1849- ) married Martha Nehemiah Munce (1853- ) Jeremiah Munce (1855- ) I have no information about when or where Robert or Jemima died. They do not appear in any census records after 1850 but it is believed by some that Robert was still alive in 1870.
